reason: The read-only $1916 byte has a conditional increment and a DTC49 consumer. It is not established as a periodic engine-event counter.
not_a_claim: The selector corrupts the counter (it only reads it).
All ghost-cam or idle modulation concepts are impossible.
next_design_requirements: Use an independently proven periodic/time/event source with known reset/overflow behaviour.
Separate phase scheduling from the retarded-idle ramp and stock protective gates.
Test with two unequal synthetic values, plus the equal-reference control.
